reviews.text: Very nice staff and great location,
Great store! Grab food, toys and even dog/cat themed gifts
Everything went better than expected. I’m completely satisfied with my visit.
Great selection of dog treats. Shop staff are welcoming.
Ilya is awesome! She also provides pet sitting services, which I used many times and my cat was always well cared after.

Litterpaw takes care of pretty much everything our cats need. Ilya takes care of ordering cases of wet food for us, setting up cat sitting services, and started stocking dry food we like to buy just for us. The store cat Punky Brewster is an icon in the neighborhood, it’s worth a visit just to say hi.
